tools.description: Search archived tool output and file versions by content, path, or symbol.

query.description: Free text, plus optional path:<glob> symbol:<name> tool:<ToolName> selectors.

tools.name: recall
tools.title: Recall

tools.description: Fetch archived content by the tool_use_id a rehydration block names, or by hash. Returns the minimum sufficient span; pass full=true only if you need the whole object.

hash.description: sha256:<64 hex>. Give exactly one of hash or tool_use_id.

tool_use_id.description: The tool_use_id a rehydration block, tombstone or recall hit names.

tools.name: expand
tools.title: Expand

tools.description: Read a captured file version (latest or historical) from the archive, never from disk. Returns the minimum sufficient span; pass full=true only if you need the whole object.

at.description: Empty for latest; else RFC3339 time, sha256:<64 hex>, or turn:<N>.

tools.name: re_read
tools.title: Re-read

tools.description: Check whether an approach was eliminated: absent, active, stale, or unavailable. Treat unavailable or unrecognized as unknown, not as absent or forbidden. Before committing to an approach, call already_tried.
tools.name: already_tried
tools.title: Already tried

tools.description: Record that an approach does not work, with its reason and the files it rests on, so it survives compaction.

depends_on.description: Paths the reason rests on; a change to one marks the record stale.

reason.description: Why it fails: what an engineer without this session's history would get wrong.

tools.name: record_eliminated
tools.title: Record eliminated

tools.description: List recorded session events over a turn or timestamp range.

from.description: Turn index, RFC3339 time, or empty for session start.

to.description: Turn index, RFC3339 time, or empty for now.

tools.name: timeline
tools.title: Timeline

tools.description: Show a recorded decision and its evidence.

decision_id.description: dec_<12 hex> id from a checkpoint or decision list.

tools.name: why
tools.title: Why

tools.description: List what Qompack recorded as omitted in this session.
tools.name: dropped
tools.title: Dropped
